text:
If only I were the moon,
if only I were the breeze,
if only I were the sun!

...

If only I were
the hour of twilight,
if only I were the moment
of your prayer!
If only I were part
of the prayer
you send alone
to God!

...

If only I were the moon,
if only I were the breeze,
if only I were the sun!...

translation.title: Rhyme LXXXVII: If Only I Were the Moon...

Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.
